ios.desc:
Explayn: experiment to better understand chemistry.

Explayn enhances traditional courses by offering a tangible and approachable explanation of concepts often presented too abstractly. To discover molecules, why not build one? To understand temperature, why not just observe how atoms increasingly vibrate as they heat up ?

To unveil all chemistry's hidden aspects, your virtual teacher Aki has several tools at his disposal: • illustrating with real-life examples • conducting virtual experiments impossible to recreate in reality • narrating the history of science, including how renowned scientists gradually deciphered chemistry and sometimes struggled to do so !

By prioritizing experimentation and avoiding unnecessary technical terms, you'll more readily grasp complex theories, even without prior knowledge.
So, embark on a groundbreaking journey in the fascinating world of chemistry with Explayn, and learn like never before!

Key Features:
- Explore a Vibrant 3D Universe: Step into a visually stunning 3D world, where chemistry is no longer confined to textbooks. Explore atomic structures, witness chemical reactions, and navigate through an environment that transforms learning into an adventure.

- Hands-on Exploration:
Interact with atoms and molecules in real-time, turning abstract concepts into tangible experiences. From discovering chemical reactions to exploring molecular bonds, our app provides a hands-on approach that fosters a deep understanding of chemistry.

- Curated Lessons by Expert Teachers:
Our comprehensive catalogue of lessons is meticulously curated by a team of experienced educators. Each lesson is crafted to cater to various learning styles, ensuring that users of all backgrounds and expertise levels find value and engagement in their educational journey.

- Gamified Learning Experience:
Learning becomes play with our gamified approach! Dive into interactive quizzes, challenges, and simulations that transform the study of chemistry into an entertaining and rewarding experience.

- Molecule Building:
Unleash your inner chemist! Our app allows you to manipulate atoms and construct molecules, fostering creativity and a practical understanding of chemical structures. Experiment with combinations and witness the outcomes in real-time.

- Future of Education:
Explayn represents the future of education. Say goodbye to traditional teaching methods and embrace an innovative, dynamic approach that captivates learners, making the study of chemistry

quotes.text: I love the idea, that's the future. However you should be aware that the explanation of second law of thermodynamics generated by the LLM you used in your app store screenshot is wrong: the LLM has it backwards. Energy transfers to less stable states from more stable states, and not the reverse. (I use LLMs for science education apps like  https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/explayn-learn-chemistry/id6448284993, so I am quite used to spot that kind of errors in LLM outputs...)
